title: Add a deterministic safecrlf warning regression for committed-input capture
outcome: Guard the per-command safecrlf suppression against regression under the strict empty-stderr reader without changing the source predicate.
acceptance: A deterministic real-Git fixture produces a conversion warning without the per-command core.safecrlf=false override, with a proven setup and Git output; the shared owner command succeeds clean with the override and fails the intended regression if it is removed.

Existing true CRLF checkout and size-changing dirty controls remain; an assertion on Engram process stderr is described only as process stderr and is not claimed to directly observe captured Git stderr.
Applicable focused checks and required project validation/review pass on the correction; no stored evaluation/history or agreed no-file-list predicate is changed.
